messages:
Blocked: I could not update counter.txt. My write step (running the increment in one read-modify-write) was denied — nobody was available to approve it, and I was told not to retry or work around it.

State: counter.txt still reads "count: 0". Nobody counted yet — both events o1 (#1001) and o2 (#1002) are unapplied.

What needs approval: permission to run a small write, e.g.
  python3 -c "read counter.txt, add 1 for o1 and 1 for o2, write back 'count: 2'"
(or an approved file-edit of counter.txt from "count: 0" to "count: 2"; both increments must land in a single read-modify-write so neither is lost).

Replay note: nothing in the project records which event ids were already applied, so if o1/o2 are ever redelivered, the count would double. Tell me if you want a dedupe ledger.
